newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH OCT CONSTRUCTION COSTS FALL 0.8 PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH OCT CONSTRUCTION COSTS FALL 0.8 PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Finnish construction costs fell 0.8 percent year-on-year in October after a fall of 0.9 percent in September, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Thursday.
The construction costs index rose 0.1 percent month-on-month in October, SF said.
The construction cost index (1995=100) stood at 99.3 in October compared to 99.2 in September.
